videos.title: Sam Altman: OpenAI, GPT-5, Sora, Board Saga, Elon Musk, Ilya, Power & AGI | Lex Fridman Podcast #419

clips.title: Sam Altman on Elon Musk's Attack: The Truth

virality.viralityRationale: Direct drama between two tech titans (Altman vs Musk) triggers strong partisan comments, debate, and immediate retention.
virality.recommendedHook: Sam Altman breaks his silence on Elon Musk's lawsuit...

subtitles.text: Elon thought OpenAI was going to fail.
He wanted total control to merge it with Tesla.
When we said no, he walked away.
Now that we succeeded, he is suing us.
It hurts because Elon was my absolute hero.
I really miss the guy who inspired builders.
True leaders shouldn't try to stifle competition.
Just build better products instead.
That is how humanity actually wins.

clips.title: Fired In 4 Minutes: The OpenAI Board Coup

virality.viralityRationale: High-stakes corporate betrayal story with insane narrative tension. Everyone remembers the 4-day firing, but Sam revealing his internal panic makes it irresistible.
virality.recommendedHook: This is exactly how I got fired from OpenAI in 4 minutes flat.

subtitles.text: I joined a Google Meet and was fired in four minutes.
My phone instantly blew up with thousands of messages.
It was so loud it crashed my phone completely.
For two days, I couldn't sleep or eat.
Adrenaline had completely hijacked my entire central nervous system.
Then seven hundred employees signed a letter threatening to quit.
That kind of loyalty gave me chills.
Never underestimate the power of culture over boardroom politics.
Because in the end, loyalty won.

clips.title: GPT-4 Sucks: The Brutal Truth About GPT-5

virality.viralityRationale: Hearing the creator of ChatGPT say 'GPT-4 kind of sucks' subverts all expectations and stops viewers scrolling instantly.
virality.recommendedHook: Sam Altman just admitted GPT-4 is actually terrible...

subtitles.text: I think GPT-4 kind of sucks.
Relative to where we need to get, it's primitive.
People use it today and think it is magic.
Wait until you see the leap from GPT-4 to GPT-5.
The delta will be just as gigantic as GPT-3 to GPT-4.
We are on an exponential curve that no human brain can grasp.
Prepare yourself, because everything is about to change.
